WITH pre AS ( SELECT * FROM ast30_book_fund_fee WHERE ast30_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = (date_trunc('month', #{p.holdDate}::date) + interval '-1day')::date ), cur AS ( SELECT * FROM ast30_book_fund_fee WHERE ast30_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = #{p.holdDate} ), occ AS ( SELECT icam10_fund_cd fund_cd , SUM(CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'C' THEN icam10_fee ELSE 0 END) occ_fee , SUM(CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'D' THEN icam10_fee ELSE 0 END) draw_fee FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND icam10_std_date BETWEEN date_trunc('month', #{p.holdDate}::date)::date AND #{p.holdDate} GROUP BY icam10_fund_cd ) SELECT ast30_fund_cd AS fund_code , ast30_fund_nm AS fund_name , ast30_pre_fee AS pre_fee , occ.occ_fee AS occ_fee , occ.draw_fee AS draw_fee , ast30_fee AS fee FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(cur.ast30_fund_cd, pre.ast30_fund_cd) AS ast30_fund_cd , COALESCE(cur.ast30_fund_nm, pre.ast30_fund_nm) AS ast30_fund_nm , pre.ast30_fee AS ast30_pre_fee , cur.ast30_fee AS ast30_fee FROM cur FULL JOIN pre ON pre.ast30_fund_cd = cur.ast30_fund_cd ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN occ ON fund_cd = ast30_fund_cd WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(ast30_fund_cd, ast30_fund_nm)) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{p.searchText})||'%' ORDER BY ast30_fund_cd
